tldr: Sun in the 2nd house routes identity and life force through livelihood and value.
body: With the Sun in the 2nd house, identity, vitality, visibility, and the need to live from a clear center move through money, resources, values, possessions, and self-worth. This makes how you earn, hold, spend, and define what is worth protecting a central part of the life. Used consciously, this placement can become presence, confidence, creative authority, and a stronger sense of purpose. Left unconscious, it can become over-identifying with this area, needing recognition here, or confusing attention with self-worth.
gift: presence, confidence, creative authority, and a stronger sense of purpose expressed through livelihood and value.
challenge: over-identifying with this area, needing recognition here, or confusing attention with self-worth concentrated in livelihood and value.
note: Authored from approved project planet-through-house material; source file was not copied into the repository.
